name: io.github.nseney1/aegis-guardrails
title: Aegis Guardrails
description: Serves a repo's coding rules to AI agents just in time; enforces them at commit and in CI.

environmentVariables.name: AEGIS_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Absolute path of one repository (it must hold .aegis/) to pin the server to; without it the server follows the host's project root or its working directory.
